data.title: 洛茜 · 礁石滩脚踏冲浪板比出胜利手势的灿烂欢呼
data.action: 单脚踩在斜插在沙滩上的黄黑相间冲浪板上，一手搭在板端，另一手高高举起比出胜利的V字手势
data.location: 塔卫二外海巨浪冲刷的黑色页岩冲浪海岸
data.lighting: 强烈的双日高空日光直射在泛着水光的冲浪板与防晒泳衣上，高对比度明艳夏日运动感
data.mood: 充满干劲、朝气蓬勃与无所畏惧的拓荒者豪情
data.description: 刚刚征服了高达三米的异星巨浪。洛茜浑身湿淋淋地拖着冲浪板走上黑沙滩，拉链半开的潜水服衬托出充满活力的健美体魄，护目镜推在棕色短发上笑得肆无忌惮。她踩着冲浪板朝管理员用力挥动手臂，阳光晒得她健康的皮肤泛起麦色光晕——「哈！管理员，看见刚才那一波漂亮的浪头了吗！塔卫二的巨浪比模拟舱刺激一万倍！再休息十分钟，下一趟冲浪比赛，你可千万别落后啊！」
data.promptProse: Fresh from riding towering breakers onto a dark shale beach, Rossi stands barefoot on the black sand in her wet lemon-yellow and carbon-black front-zip wetsuit monokini with goggles pushed up onto her forehead. Bracing one foot boldly on her yellow-and-black surfboard planted in the sand, she flashes a high-energy peace sign and wide sun-drenched grin toward the viewer. Harsh midday sun glints brightly off crashing turquoise waves and droplets beading across her neoprene swimwear.
data.animaCaption: Standing on the black sand beach with one foot propped on her surfboard in a wet yellow-and-black front-zip wetsuit monokini, Rossi flashes a triumphant peace sign and bright grin with goggles pushed up on her head. Midday sunlight gleams over crashing surf behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a wet lemon-yellow and carbon-black ergonomic wetsuit monokini with its front zipper pulled partly open over her athletic figure.
